0022600133.text: The Washington Wizards, 2-2 and coming off a loss, visit the Cleveland Cavaliers, who are 2-1 and riding a two-game winning streak, with Washington ninth in the East and Cleveland eighth. Washington is 1-1 on the road and will be without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Justin Champagnie is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, but Cleveland swept all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently beating Washington 130-117 in Cleveland on April 12, 2026.
